headline: Rakam Infrastructures files substantial acquisition disclosure for Almondz Global Securities
sum: Rakam Infrastructures Private Limited has disclosed a substantial acquisition of shares in Almondz Global Securities Limited under SEBI Takeover Regulations Regulation 31(4), signalling a significant change in shareholding structure of the listed entity.
detail: Rakam Infrastructures Private Limited submitted a mandatory disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 to NSE regarding its shareholding in Almondz Global Securities Limited. The disclosure was filed as required when a person acquires shares aggregating to 25% or more of the total shareholding, or announces an intention to acquire such shares. The filing establishes the acquirer's identity, acquisition method, and timing.
